confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors draw on web-search results for Arica from crowdsourced aggregators (Expatistan, Livingcost, Nomad Watch, citycost.org and similar) and Chile-wide restaurant price guides. These have few contributors and disagree, so I used bounded central values, converting CLP at roughly 920-950 per USD as implied by those results (not independently verified). The mid-range dinner for two is the least certain food anchor: sources span about US$29-56, and one includes wine. I found no Arica-specific wine-glass or restaurant cocktail price. Cocktail (about 1.9x beer) and wine glass (about 1.3x beer) are therefore set from the beer relationship, cross-checked against an Arica club cocktail figure (about CLP 7,575) and non-Arica Chilean menus. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July 2026 low/shoulder season, not live listings. The FX figure is as reported in search results from RBA pages and was not re-verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Northern Chilean coastal and border city. Expatistan rates it about the same cost of living as Iquique, and a cost-of-living comparison puts it somewhat cheaper than Santiago. Chile-wide restaurant averages were used as a cross-check, and lodging was scaled from similar secondary tourist cities in northern Chile.
